== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[AT-AT Cannon (PC Errata 2016 disc card)]]. Compared with [[AT-AT Cannon (PC Errata 2013 slip)]] (16 April 2013). The 2013 slip and the same area of the disc image, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).

SHA-1 <code>984cad6a0c46629a4bead8b795777987245ce2a7</code>.

Fair use rationale: crops of copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card images, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. (errata by the Players Committee), used only to show the differences between versions on this non-commercial fan wiki.
